tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List all available Pine Script v6 documentation files with descriptions. Returns files organised by category with descriptions. For small files use get_doc(path). For large files (ta.md, strategy.md, collections.md, drawing.md, general.md) use list_sections(path) then get_section(path, header).

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List all section headers in a doc file. Use before get_section() to find the right header. Especially useful for large files like ta.md, strategy.md, collections.md, drawing.md, general.md which have 50-115 sections each.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read a specific Pine Script v6 documentation file. For large files (ta.md, strategy.md, collections.md, drawing.md, general.md) prefer list_sections() + get_section() to avoid loading 1000-2800 line files into context.

params.name: path
params.description: Relative path to the documentation file (e.g., "reference/functions/ta.md")

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum characters to return. Use 30000 for large files to avoid token limits.

params.name: offset
params.description: Character offset to start reading from (default: 0)

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Get a specific section from a documentation file by its header. Use after list_sections() shows available headers, or after resolve_topic() / search_docs() identifies the relevant file.

params.name: header
params.description: Header text to find (e.g., "strategy.exit()" or "## strategy.exit()")

params.name: include_children
params.description: Include nested subsections under the header (default: True)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Pine Script v6 documentation and return matching sections. Finds sections containing the query and returns previews with get_section() call hints so you can read the full content.

tools.name: get_functions
tools.description: Get valid Pine Script v6 functions, optionally filtered by namespace. Use before writing Pine Script to see which functions exist. For checking a single function name, use validate_function() instead.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Filter by namespace (e.g., "ta", "strategy", "request"). Empty string returns all functions grouped by namespace.

tools.name: validate_function
tools.description: Check if a Pine Script v6 function name is valid.

tools.name: resolve_topic
tools.description: Fast lookup for exact Pine Script API terms and known concepts. Use for exact function names and Pine Script vocabulary (e.g., "ta.rsi", "strategy.entry", "repainting", "request.security"). For natural language questions, read the docs://manifest resource for routing guidance, then use get_doc() or list_sections() + get_section().

params.name: query
params.description: Exact Pine Script term or known concept keyword.

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description: List all available prompts. Returns JSON with prompt metadata including name, description, and optional arguments.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Get a prompt by name with optional arguments. Returns the rendered prompt as JSON with a messages array. Arguments should be provided as a dict mapping argument names to values.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the prompt to get

prompts.name: debug_error
prompts.description: Debug a Pine Script compilation error.

prompts.name: convert_v5_to_v6
prompts.description: Convert Pine Script v5 code to v6.

prompts.name: explain_function
prompts.description: Explain a Pine Script function in detail.
